Parallel DNS query sender with UDP and TCP fallback handling.

# Purpose
[`fd_res_msend_rc`](<#fd_res_msend_rc>) implements a DNS resolver transport routine that can send multiple queries and collect multiple replies over UDP, with TCP fallback when a reply is truncated. It uses the resolver configuration in `fd_resolvconf_t` to build the list of name server addresses, open a nonblocking socket, send each query to all configured servers, and wait for replies with `poll`. It accepts only valid positive or negative DNS responses, retries `SERVFAIL` replies, and stores each accepted answer in the caller supplied buffers with the reply length in `alens`.

The file also contains helper code for socket cleanup, monotonic time measurement, TCP Fast Open setup, and `msghdr` advancement for partial send and receive operations. The main function is an internal resolver backend, not a public application entry point. It handles both IPv4 and IPv6 name servers, including mixed address sets and fallback when IPv6 is not available on the system.
